atoms.text: Princess Icy wants to tell you about her home. Will you learn about the South Pole with her?

instruction.text: Princess Icy wants to find her home on a world map. Can you point out the South Pole to her?

feedback.end: The South Pole is the most southern point on Earth. It is located in Antarctica.

instruction.text: Just like the North Pole, the South Pole is very cold. Select the images of things you might see there.
Find the seal in this image to tell Princess Icy a fun fact about the South Pole.

feedback.end: Unlike the North Pole, the South Pole is located on land in Antarctica. It was first visited by a Norwegian explorer in 1911.

instruction.text: The South Pole is on the opposite side of Earth from the North Pole. Answer Princess Icy’s question.

hint.text: When the sun is in the sky for six months at one pole, it is dark for six months at the other pole.

atoms.a: “When King Snowy sees sunlight at the North Pole, what do I see at the South Pole?”
